title: More is Less: The Pitfalls of Multi-Model Synthetic Preference Data in DPO Safety Alignment

summary.claim: DPO on synthetic preference data from multiple models raises general benchmark scores but also raises jailbreak attack success. Using only the target model's own responses is better for safety.
summary.condition: DPO safety alignment on Llama, Mistral and Qwen; worst when a stronger model (e.g., GPT-4o) gives the chosen response and the target model the rejected one.
summary.gap: (Inferred) It is not checked whether the proposed cause (high linear separability leading to shallow cues) also applies to other alignment methods such as PPO.
